summary: Full backend + frontend verification of iteration-2 features (product images/variants, Partners account, bank live-data connections & matching, Netgsm SMS + IMAP/SMTP mail, contact location, quick-message modals). Backend: 55 pytest cases, 53 passing (96%). Frontend: all requested flows exercised on the public preview URL; stock images/variants, scanner variant adjust, partners (add/tx/profit), bank connect+sync+match+auto-match, SMS center, quick messages on contacts/invoices/orders, contact location and sidebar nav all work. Two real defects found (match-rule duplicate 500, seeded contact phone numbers are landlines so every SMS to seeded caris fails) plus a CORS credentials misconfiguration that I fixed in backend/.env.

critical.issue: Creating a rule whose pattern already exists returns 500. Upsert uses {"$set": doc} where doc contains _id -> pymongo WriteError 'Performing an update on the path _id would modify the immutable field _id'. Reproduced in UI: 'Kural Ekle' with pattern 'POS Blokeli' shows toast 'Kural eklenemedi.' Fix: pop _id from the $set payload and use $setOnInsert for _id/created_at.

All seeded contacts (cnt_01..cnt_04) have landline phones (0212/0312/0216...). comm_service.normalize_phone only accepts 5XXXXXXXXX, so every quick message / bulk campaign against seeded caris is logged as 'Geçersiz GSM numarası' (failed). Bulk campaign 'Tümünü Seç -> Gönder' therefore reports 0 sent / 4 failed. Fix seed phones to 05XX numbers (or add a separate mobile field).

minor.issue: BankConnection.provider_name has no default, so a payload without provider_name returns 422 before the provider/account validation (400/404) can run. Make provider_name optional (server overwrites it anyway).
For invalid numbers the log stores the raw template ('Sayın {ad} bakiye {bakiye}') instead of the personalized text used for valid recipients.

Origin correctly returns 502 + JSON detail, but the Cloudflare edge replaces 5xx bodies with an HTML error page, so the browser cannot read `detail`. Consider returning 200 with {ok:false,...} or a 4xx (e.g. 424/409) for upstream mail failures so the UI can surface the real reason.

IMAP error text is the bytes repr (b'[ALERT] Invalid credentials (Failure)'), shown to the user as '[binary data omitted]' in the mail error banner. Decode/normalize IMAP errors before storing last_error.

backend/.env had CORS_ORIGINS="*" while CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True -> all withCredentials requests from a different origin fail preflight ('Access-Control-Allow-Origin must not be *'). I set explicit origins in backend/.env (preview URL + http://localhost:3000). server.py still hardcodes a '*' fallback (os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','*')) - remove the wildcard default.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration error) fires on every page
Seeded product NX-CHG-15W image URL returns 404 (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1622445262464-84b1456045b6?w=500) so a broken-image alt text is rendered in the table

integration_issues.issue: Adding a rule with an existing pattern -> backend 500 -> toast 'Kural eklenemedi.' (see backend critical #1)
Select-all + send fires the API, but all 4 seeded recipients fail with 'Geçersiz GSM numarası' (landline seed phones); log rows show Hata. Functionally the campaign endpoint works.

Frontend calls the external preview URL; the ingress/Cloudflare rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*', so all withCredentials POST/PUT (image upload, variants save, mail account, etc.) are blocked by CORS from localhost. Frontend UI testing must be done on the public preview URL (which now renders fine in headless Chrome).

issues: Error banner shows '[binary data omitted]' instead of a readable IMAP error message
Broken external image renders raw alt text, breaking row alignment

action_items: Change seeded contact phones to mobile 05XX numbers so SMS quick-message/campaign demos succeed.
Give BankConnection.provider_name a default so invalid provider/account return 400/404 instead of 422.
Decode IMAP/SMTP error bytes before storing last_error (mail error banner shows '[binary data omitted]').
Return a browser-readable error for mail upstream failures (edge strips 502 JSON bodies).
Remove the '*' CORS fallback in server.py (env now sets explicit origins) and keep allow_credentials with explicit origins.
Log the personalized message (not the raw {ad}/{bakiye} template) for invalid-number SMS logs.
Fix <span> inside <option> in MainLayout and replace the 404 unsplash image for NX-CHG-15W.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1932 lines - split into routers (products, banking, comm, integrations) per the 700-line guideline.
get_current_user still falls back to the demo admin when no token is present, so every endpoint is effectively public (carried over from iteration 1).
clean_doc returns both id and _id; the raw _id key leaks the Mongo field name into every API response (mail account response is returned with _id first).
bank_providers/comm_service simulated modes are clearly labelled (SİMÜLE badges, [SİMÜLE] toasts) - good; keep the same labelling if real credentials are added.
distribute-profit and partner transactions correctly guard insufficient balance / non-zero-balance deletion; matching correctly rejects already-matched transactions.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) create_match_rule builds a full doc including _id and passes it to update_one({...},{'$set': doc}, upsert=True); when a rule with that company_id+pattern already exists Mongo rejects modifying _id -> WriteError -> unhandled 500. 2) Seed data gives caris landline phone numbers while comm_service.normalize_phone only accepts Turkish GSM (5XXXXXXXXX), so the SMS pipeline classifies every seeded recipient as invalid; the endpoint returns status 'partial' with failed==N and the UI shows Hata rows. 3) CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS='*' is rejected by browsers for credentialed requests; the app only worked because the preview serves frontend and API from the same origin.
